recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-expand the old commented classification material for FHIR-7038; any broader Resource Guide expansion should come from a new work-group decision that supersedes the current subset-and-patterns intent.
issue_request: FHIR-7038 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core-toc issue against the May 2015 resourceguide.html page. It reported missing content and was resolved to provide content, with a Jira comment saying the work was under way on a separate task.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-7038. Source history shows resourceguide.html was a placeholder before August 2015; commits 014e9d175437d999b5090e29b7488198cb5e9263 and bb5e3f2a9fcb50aecda21994cda00fdc6981b0c8 added substantive Resource Guide content. Related Resource Guide issues FHIR-7663 and FHIR-5374 both cite SVN revision 6741, matching bb5e3f2a9f and the separate-task trail.
additional_context: The current combined branch builds resourceguide.html through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Later accepted issues FHIR-13042 and FHIR-43371 narrowed the page: old classification content was intentionally removed from the rendered page, and FHIR-I minutes confirmed the page is a subset guide rather than a full resource inventory.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source is already correct for FHIR-7038 after considering the historical application and later Resource Guide decisions.
